name: score-v3
description: The speed gate's workload (owner, 2026-10-08: arko_index defaults to exact flat search): the geometric mean of two parts' single-thread QPS of flat search with int8 codes (flat-int8), which must reach recall@10 0.95, over all base vectors. The parts are code-voyagecode4-200k (arko_index chunks of 12 code checkouts, voyage-code-4; first 1,000 held-out queries) and docs-voyage4-200k (Cloudflare and MDN documentation, voyage-4; first 2,000 queries), both 1024 dimensions (docs/datasets.md). Frozen: changing this file changes the score's identity.
